description.value: Over a long rest, using gadgeteer's implements, you assemble a personal harness studded with gadget mounts. It becomes an enhanced item usable only by you, requires attunement, and serves as a tech focus for your tech powers while attuned. It offers 4 modification slots at the outset and more as you gain levels, following the engineer table's Modification Slots column. Each gadget installed beyond your proficiency bonus reduces your tech point maximum by 1. During a long rest you may install, swap, or remove gadgets up to your Intelligence modifier (minimum one). Any gadget effect requiring a saving throw uses your tech save DC.
